rho_reference.protocol: PLAN s2/s4 and ANALYSIS_PLAN s9 name rho-neg (rho.negation) as the matched rho, paired with ic on the same (workload, target, round), and rho-cubic (rho.cubic, the order-6 automorphism fold) on the V5 j = 0 crater (census A3 F1). rho-neg is the strongest available on all 648 V6 vertices and the 63 non-crater V5 vertices (j not in {0, 1728}, prime fields); on the V5 crater (p = 1 and r = 1 mod 3) the strongest is rho-cubic, and the report compares IC with it there (89.3x / 98.2x / 141.2x at 0 / 0.1 / 1 GAE). H-T's denominator is rho-neg at j != 0 sources, the strongest there.
rho_reference.unit: S (ecbench normalised group operations: total_gae / sqrt(r)), the unpriced native operations each arm names (cost.unpriced, from records.jsonl per A2.1) priced at 0 / 0.1 / 1 GAE on both arms
rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench sha256 ac4bc5b26f858a4d8a374208297157840af25fb1dc25ea1c19dd41360735fb35 (runs/progress.jsonl header and every record); every arm, references included, in the same sessions
rho_reference.note: gae_band: V6 pooled mean priced S of ic and rho-neg over (ic, rho-neg) pairs of the isogenous families (the Q1 population). gae_band_by_volcano adds V5 levels 1-6 (rho-neg) and V5crater (ic against rho-cubic, D + N pairs; rho-neg shown for reference). Rho is ahead at every price, every level of both volcanoes and on the crater; the ratio is the distance remaining, not a pass/fail.
